context: Aerial search over a sea environment for a missing robot, person, or debris. The mission involves scanning moving water from altitude to identify small, anomalous objects on the surface. Key visual cues include unnatural geometric shapes, contrasting colors against the water, splashing, or floating objects that disrupt the wave pattern.
natural_list: Ocean waves, whitecaps, sea foam, shadows, sun glare, floating seaweed, driftwood, marine animals, kelp patches, current ripples
priority_signals: 1. Unnatural geometric shapes or rigid lines (distinguishing from organic curves of driftwood or seaweed by looking for straight edges or right angles). 2. Sustained contrasting color or brightness anomalies that do not blend with surrounding wave patterns (distinguishing from whitecaps which are fleeting and move with the wind, whereas targets persist). 3. Splashing or localized water disturbance without wind context (distinguishing from wave breaks by noting if the disturbance is out of sync with surrounding wave motion). 4. Shadows on the water surface that do not match wave shapes (distinguishing from wave troughs by checking if the shadow shape matches a solid object above it).
target_objects: Person: Head and shoulders visible, skin or clothing colors, rhythmic splashing. Bot/Robot: Metallic or brightly colored geometric shape, possible antenna or protrusions, may be partially submerged. Debris: Wood, fiberglass, metal fragments, life jackets, flotation devices, often with sharp edges or bright colors.
platform_notes: Aerial platform (drone or helicopter). Ignore lens glare, water droplets on the camera lens, aircraft interior reflections, or propeller shadows moving across the water surface.
color_shift_notes: Water color changes drastically with sun angle, depth, and cloud cover; bright glare can wash out colors entirely, making bright objects appear white, while shadows can make dark objects blend into deep water. Rely on shape, texture, and motion rather than color alone, as white targets can vanish in whitecaps and dark targets can vanish in deep troughs.
name: sea
